changes.reason: Adds a Node production path for @vitejs/plugin-rsc builds: loadRscBuild loads each build into a worker thread of its own, RenderServer renders through it, and the Node adapters can pin the origin a server answers for.

kubernetes.reason: Two separately built Vite RSC fixtures are served from one Node process by @hono/node-server through createNodeComposedHandler, RenderServer and loadRscBuild, answering HTML, Flight, client assets, a stale manifest, a forged Host header and per-tenant requests over real HTTP.
constraints: Each build runs in a node:worker_threads worker; runtime context and action input must be plain data.
With origin set, health probes must send the public host; a server should exit on build.closed so its supervisor restarts it.
Requires the @vitejs/plugin-rsc default dist/rsc, dist/ssr and dist/client layout and the root Vite base.
The build and the server must use the same NODE_ENV.
Local host-runtime evidence does not certify a deployed Kubernetes cluster.

evidence.testName: Node RSC production build host serves a Vite RSC build as HTML, Flight and client assets over a real Node HTTP server

aws-lambda.reason: loadRscBuild and its worker run on any Node process, but no Lambda packaging of a plugin-rsc build, worker start-up per container, or buffered Lambda delivery of its HTML and Flight was exercised.
constraints: No Lambda RSC integration or deployment evidence is claimed.
The buffered Lambda response contract is unchanged.

cloudflare.reason: A Node Container could run the same Node server, but no container host was exercised. Worker isolates are not claimed: loadRscBuild reads the build from the filesystem and starts node:worker_threads workers.
constraints: No Workers isolate support is added; loadRscBuild needs node:fs and node:worker_threads.
No Cloudflare Node Container evidence is claimed.
